## 🚀 Overview

I’m thrilled to share my **new Slim Safe Travel Box**, tailor-made for the **Nintendo Switch 2**. This sleek, low-profile case cradles your console and both Joy-Con controllers. The reduced volume keeps your pack light and pocketable—perfect for commuting, vacation, or any on-the-go gaming session!

## 🧩 Model Variants

| Variant | Description | File Suffix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🎨 **Single-Color** | Subtly embossed logo, one-filament print | \_slim\_Single\_Color.3mf |
| 🌈 **Multi-Color** | Contrasting logo for that extra pop | \_slim\_Multi\_Color.3mf |

## 🖨️ Recommended Print Settings

- **Perimeters:** 3
- **Layer Height:** 0.28 mm
- **Infill:** 10 % Gyroid (light yet sturdy)
- **Supports:** ❌ None required
- **Build Plate:** Heated or unheated bed (PLA-friendly)

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This model is provided **as-is** for the **Nintendo Switch 2** only. I **will not** be liable for any damage to your console or accessories. Use responsibly and double-check fit before inserting your device.

✨ Ready to print? Snap a photo of your finished case and share your tweaks below. Happy printing and safe travels! 🎮✈️
